title: CRLR/224/2022 of TANUJ PASWAN Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
CRLR No. 224 of 2020
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Pradeep Chamiyal, Advocate for
the revisionist.
Mr. V.S. Rathore, A.G.A. for the State.
Mr. Amit Kapri, Advocate for the
respondent no.2.
During the course of hearing, it is
expressed that perhaps if efforts are made,
the parties may amicably settle the dispute.
Let call both the parties on
21.12.2022 so as to explore the possibility
of amicable settlement between them.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 02.12.2022
Jitendra
